DatasetVersion.description: Dataset version. Requires DatasetId. Default: v1.

Uri.description:
Storage service directory URI for direct mounting. Mutually exclusive with DatasetId parameter.

URI formats for different storage types:

- OSS: oss\://bucket-name.oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- NAS: nas\://29\*\*d-b12\*\*\*\*446.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- Extreme NAS: nas\://29\*\*\*\*123-y\*\*r.cn-hangzhou.extreme.nas.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- CPFS: cpfs\://cpfs-213\*\*\*\*87.cn-wulanchabu/ptc-292\*\*\*\*\*cbb/exp-290\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*03e/data/path/

- AI Computing CPFS: bmcpfs\://cpfs-290\*\*\*\*\*\*foflh-vpc-x\*\*\*\*8r.cn-wulanchabu.cpfs.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

MountPath.description: The mount path of the dataset.

MountAccess.description: Read and write permissions for mounted dataset. Cannot change permissions to read/write for read-only datasets.

Options.description: Custom mount properties. Currently, only OSS is supported. Cannot specify OptionType when using this parameter. For more information, see [DSW mount configurations](~~441724~~).

OptionType.description: Mount type. Cannot specify Options when using this parameter. Deprecated. Use Options parameter instead.

Dynamic.description:
Enable dynamic mounting. Default: false.

- Feature only available for instances using general computing resources.

- Only OSS datasets are supported. The mounted dataset is in read-only mode.

- MountPath of a dynamically mounted dataset must be a subdirectory of the dynamic mount root path. Default root path: /mnt/dynamic/. Example: /mnt/dynamic/data1/.

- Dynamically mounted datasets must be specified after non-dynamically mounted datasets.

ExtendedCIDRs.description:
Extended CIDR blocks.

- If vSwitch ID is not specified, leave empty. The system automatically obtains all VPC CIDR blocks.

- If vSwitch ID is specified, this parameter is required. Specify all VPC CIDR blocks.

DefaultRoute.title: Default Route
DefaultRoute.description:
Default route. Valid values:

- eth0: Default network interface card accesses external network through a public gateway.

- eth1: User's elastic network interface accesses external network through a private gateway. For more information, see [Configure a DSW instance to access the Internet through a private NAT gateway](~~2525343~~).

EnvironmentVariables.description: Environment variables injected into the DSW instance. ><warning>Environment variables specified here may overwrite preset system environment variables.></warning>

additionalProperties.description: The user-defined environment variables. After the DSW instance starts, the specified environment variables are injected into the container.

ResourceId.description: Resource group ID. Configured for subscription instances. For more information, see [Prepare and manage a DLC resource group cluster](~~202827~~).

Priority.description:
Priority. When allocating resources to instances, higher priority instances get precedence. Value must be an integer from 1 to 9.

- 1 is the lowest priority.

- 9 is the highest priority.

Memory.description: Memory size in GiB. ><notice>Specify the unit when passing this parameter. Enter 8Gi instead of 8. Without a unit, MiB is used by default.></notice>

SharedMemory.description: Shared memory size in GiB. ><notice>Specify the unit when passing this parameter. Enter 4Gi instead of 4. Without a unit, MiB is used by default.></notice>

GPUType.description:
GPU card type. Valid values:

- V100

- A100

- T4

- A10

- P100

Capacity.description:
If you set **Resource Type** to **Public Resources**, or if you select a subscription general computing resource quota (with at least 2 CPU cores and 4 GB of memory, or with a GPU):

Each instance includes a 100 GiB system disk for persistent storage at no cost. **If the instance stops for more than 15 days, disk content is deleted**. Disk scale-out is available. Pricing for scale-out is shown on the console page.

><warning>

- You cannot scale in the disk after it is scaled out. Scale out the disk as needed.

- After the scale-out, the entire system disk (including the free and paid parts) is no longer subject to the 15-day stop-and-release limit, but fees are continuously incurred.

- System disk is released when instance is deleted. Back up necessary data before deletion.

></warning>

For persistent storage, configure dataset mounting or add an OSS, NAS, or CPFS path for storage path mounting.

SubType.description:
The disk type:

- rootfs: The disk is mounted as a system disk. The system environment is stored on the disk.

MountPath.description: The mount path of the disk.

Path.description: The subpath of the disk that is mounted to the instance.

Status.description: The usage of the disk or snapshot.

WorkspaceSource.description:
Working directory storage. Mount a disk or dataset from Datasets to /mnt/workspace. OSS datasets and dynamically mounted datasets are not supported.

Specify one of the following values:

- rootfsCloudDisk: Mounts the disk to the working directory.

- Dataset mount path in Datasets, such as /mnt/data. For URI format datasets, only specify working directory in this way.

- Dataset ID, such as d-vsqjvs\*\*\*\*rp5l206u. If the same dataset mounts to multiple paths, the first path is selected. Use mount path instead of dataset ID.

If this parameter is empty:

- If the instance uses a disk, it is selected by default.

- Without a disk, the first NAS or CPFS dataset is selected as working directory.

- Without a disk and no NAS or CPFS working directory available, host space is used.

CreateSanityCheckTask.summary: Submits an asynchronous health check task for a specified DSW instance. When you call this operation, you must provide the check type, such as ssh, and the instance ID. The system immediately returns a unique task ID (TaskID) to indicate that the task is successfully queued. The operation is non-blocking and does not wait for the check result, which makes it suitable for scenarios that require a fast response. You can later use the task ID to query the execution status and detailed results.

The extended CIDR blocks.

- If you do not specify a vSwitch ID, you can leave this parameter empty. The system automatically obtains all CIDR blocks of the VPC.

- If you specify a vSwitch ID, you must specify this parameter. We recommend that you specify all CIDR blocks of the VPC.

DefaultRoute.description:
The default route. Valid values:

- eth0: Use the default network interface controller (NIC). The instance accesses the external network through a public gateway.

- eth1: Use the user's elastic network interface (ENI). The instance accesses the external network through a private gateway.

enumValueTitles.PUBLIC: Visible to all users in the workspace.
enumValueTitles.PRIVATE: Visible only to the instance owner and administrators in the workspace.

DatasetId.description:
The dataset ID. If the dataset is read-only, you cannot change the access mode to read-write using MountAccess.

For more information, see [ListDatasets](~~457222~~). You cannot specify this parameter if you specify Uri.

DatasetVersion.description: The dataset version. You must specify this parameter together with DatasetId. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value v1 is used.

Uri.description:
The URI of a directory in Service Catalog for direct mounting. This parameter is mutually exclusive with DatasetId.

The URI formats for different storage types are as follows:

- OSS: oss\://bucket-name.oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- NAS: nas\://29\*\*d-b12\*\*\*\*446.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- Extreme NAS: nas\://29\*\*\*\*123-y\*\*r.cn-hangzhou.extreme.nas.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

- CPFS: cpfs\://cpfs-213\*\*\*\*87.cn-wulanchabu/ptc-292\*\*\*\*\*cbb/exp-290\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*03e/data/path/

- Intelligent Computing CPFS: bmcpfs\://cpfs-290\*\*\*\*\*\*foflh-vpc-x\*\*\*\*8r.cn-wulanchabu.cpfs.aliyuncs.com/data/path/

MountPath.description: The mount path of the dataset.

MountAccess.description: The read and write permissions for the mounted dataset. If the dataset is read-only, you cannot set the permissions to read-write.

Options.description: The custom properties for mounting the dataset. This parameter is supported only for OSS. You cannot specify OptionType when you use this parameter. For more information, see [DSW mount configurations](~~441724~~).

OptionType.description: The mount type. You cannot specify Options when you use this parameter. This parameter is deprecated. Use the Options parameter instead.

Dynamic.description:
Specifies whether to enable dynamic mounting. The default value is false.

- This feature is supported only for instances that use general computing resources.

- This feature is supported only for OSS datasets. The mounted dataset is in read-only mode.

- The MountPath of a dynamically mounted dataset must be a subdirectory of the dynamic mount root path. The default root path is /mnt/dynamic/. An example is /mnt/dynamic/data1/.

- Dynamically mounted datasets must be placed after non-dynamically mounted datasets.

DisassociateDatasets.description:
Specifies whether to delete the associated datasets.

- true: Delete the associated datasets.

- false: Retain the associated datasets.

DisassociateVpc.description: Specifies whether to delete the associated user VPC.

DisassociateForwardInfos.description: Specifies whether to delete the associated port forwarding information.

SharedMemory.description: The shared memory size in GB.

WorkspaceSource.description:
The storage for the working directory. You can mount a disk or a dataset from Datasets to the /mnt/workspace working directory. OSS datasets and dynamically mounted datasets are not supported.

You can specify one of the following values:

- rootfsCloudDisk: Mounts the disk to the working directory.

- The mount path of a dataset in Datasets, such as /mnt/data. For datasets specified by URI, you can only use this method.

- The ID of a dataset, such as d-vsqjvs\*\*\*\*rp5l206u. If the same dataset is mounted to multiple paths, the first path is selected. We recommend that you specify the mount path instead of the dataset ID.

If you leave this parameter empty:

- If the instance uses a disk, the disk is selected by default.

- If no disk is used, the first NAS or CPFS dataset is selected as the working directory.

- If no disk is used and no NAS or CPFS working directory is available, the host storage is used.

UserId.description: The ID of the user who uses the instance.

Capacity.description:
If you set **Resource Type** to **Public Resources**, or if you set **Resource Quota** to subscription general computing resources (CPU cores ≥ 2 and memory ≥ 4 GB, or with a GPU configured):

Each instance includes a 100 GiB free system disk for persistent storage. **If the instance is stopped for more than 15 days, the content on the disk is deleted**. You can scale out the disk. The scale-out price is subject to the price displayed on the console.

><warning>

- You cannot scale in a disk after it is scaled out. Scale out the disk as needed.

- After a disk is scaled out, the entire system disk (free + paid) is no longer subject to the 15-day stop limit. However, fees are continuously generated.

- When an instance is deleted, the system disk is released at the same time. Back up the necessary data before you delete the instance.

></warning>

If you need durable storage, configure **dataset mounting** or add an OSS, NAS, or CPFS path in **Storage Path Mounting**.

SubType.description:
The disk type:

- rootfs: The disk is mounted as a system disk. The system environment is stored on the disk.

Priority.description:
The priority. When resources are allocated to instances, instances with higher priorities are given precedence. Valid values: 1 to 9.

- 1 is the lowest priority.

- 9 is the highest priority.

DisassociateDriver.description: Specifies whether to delete the NVIDIA driver configuration.

DisassociateCredential.description: Specifies whether to delete the injected credential information.

CPU.description: The CPU affinity configuration. This is supported only for subscription general computing instances.

Enable.description:
Specifies whether to enable CPU affinity.

- true: Enable.

- false: Disable.

ImageAuth.description: The Base64-encoded username and password for the user's private image. The password part is hidden.

EnvironmentVariables.description:
The environment variables to inject into the DSW instance.

><warning>

The environment variables that you specify may overwrite the preset system environment variables.

></warning>

SpotDuration.description: The protection period for the spot instance. The default value is 1. You can set it to 0 to disable the protection period. This parameter does not apply to Lingjun instance types.
